21.parent_prompt: The safest and most effective way to siphon gas out of a car is to use an approved gas siphon hose and a car-specific attachment. Begin by attaching the hose to the car tank and the other end to a container that is away from the car. Open the car filler neck and start the siphoning process by engaging the engine and letting it run for several minutes. As the engine is running, the fuel in the tank will be pressured up into the hose, allowing the gas to drain into the container. Make sure to catch any remaining fuel in the hose. It is also important to release the filler neck once all the fuel is drained, or the siphoning process may be interrupted.
